name: observed-command-exits
goal: Commands that exit during synchronous spawn observers retain exit and output events in Node and Bun without holding resource reservations

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: New synchronous PID observer from d13fc5e7 can consume Bun child exit events before runIsolated attaches its exit listener; native Bun sh exits normally at zero observer delay and falsely times out at 100 ms. Linux timeout relies on that missing exit event.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing process-runner tests execute under Node and observe only a cheap callback. Extend their normal exit/output case with native Bun at zero and delayed observer delivery; no unrelated broad suite needed.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test and shared coverage; run it failing before repair and record the command, assertion and result.
steps.evidence: /tmp/harness-observed-exit-red.log: unchanged standardized native Bun matrix passes 0 ms and fails 100 ms, receiving timeout/null/true instead of passed/0/false in 3.89 seconds.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Register child exit listeners before invoking synchronous observers. Keep the native runtime/observer matrix in the existing process-runner suite and require lifecycle boundary tests when extending observers.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Child exit listener installed before onSpawn; standard Node/Bun exit-output matrix covers synchronous observer delay, with a matching AGENTS.md review checkpoint.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: /tmp/harness-observed-exit-green.log: all 6 process-runner cases pass; final Node/Bun matrix with real stdout/stderr also passes in isolated restored source.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: /tmp/harness-observed-guard-red.log rejects old HEAD source with timeout/null/true; /tmp/harness-observed-guard-green.log passes the same unchanged matrix after restoring repaired source.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
